 How to Watch Pelicans vs Jazz

 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 New Orleans enters Friday's matchup looking to rebound from a 123-120 loss to the Indiana Pacers in Wednesday's season opener. Dejounte Murray led the Pelicans with 23 points and seven assists, while Zion Williamson contributed 22 points. Yves Missi grabbed 14 rebounds as New Orleans controlled the glass, outrebounding Indiana 49-43. The Pelicans built a 66-56 halftime advantage and carried a six-point lead into the fourth quarter but struggled down the stretch, getting outscored 37-28 in the final period as Indiana completed the comeback.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Utah also opened its season with a defeat, falling 123-103 to the Memphis Grizzlies on Wednesday. Keyonte George paced the Jazz with 22 points and five assists, shooting 7-for-12 from the field and connecting on four three-pointers. Lauri Markkanen added 18 points and nine rebounds, while Jaren Jackson Jr. contributed 15 points and five rebounds. Ace Bailey scored 12 points off the bench, and Jaxson Hayes recorded six blocks. Utah held a 31-29 lead after the first quarter but was outscored 35-20 in the second period before fading away in the second half.
